notes_title: What changed, and what to check
notes: v4: checked against your board (Menards 3/16" white hardboard). As traced from the photo, the hook couldn't hang flush: the S-bend met the board face about 3 mm below the hole. The S-bend now passes through the hole one inch above the pin at 12° (its front corner is 3.3 mm higher than traced, and the bends are tighter), and it clears the hole by 0.2 mm per side. Check: (1) does your steel hook sit flush against the board? If so, the photo was off at that corner and this is right. (2) Does the shape still look like your hook? Prints on its side in PETG, no supports; good for light things.
